snippet.title: Schrödinger's Call Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
When the world is coming to an end, who would you want to speak to one last time? This heartfelt visual novel explores the pain and salvation of human connection through a beautifully illustrated, storybook-inspired experience.

Learn more about the showcase here: theindiepremier.com
